$comment: OG-SEC-002. Trust zones, action tiers and connection levels as data. Declared policy only: OctopusG v0.2 executes nothing and every approval is a labelled simulation. Source: docs/06-SECURITY-AND-APPROVALS.md.

trustZones.label: Owner's Mac
trustZones.notes: Enrolled. Read-only Git observation in v0.2; allowlisted local actions are deferred to v0.5.

trustZones.label: Owner's personal Windows laptop
trustZones.notes: Enrolled only after the agent contract is stable (v0.5). Nothing runs on it now.

trustZones.label: Company-owned laptop
trustZones.notes: BROWSER_ONLY / UNMANAGED / NO_LOCAL_ACCESS. No agent, scan, credential or employer-system change without explicit written employer authorization.

trustZones.label: Provider accounts
trustZones.notes: Scoped credentials, level ceilings and action tiers arrive with the first connector in v0.3.

levels.name: declared
levels.meaning: Recorded in the registry; nothing is connected.

levels.name: prepare
levels.meaning: Draft or plan a change; nothing is applied.

levels.name: approved action
levels.meaning: Apply a change for which an approval is recorded.

levels.name: controlled automation
levels.meaning: Named action with a fixed template, T0-T2 only.

tiers.name: Observe
tiers.examples: Git status, deployment health, message arrival

tiers.name: Prepare
tiers.examples: Email draft, migration plan, config diff

tiers.name: Reversible
tiers.examples: Run tests, create branch, restart preview

tiers.name: Critical
tiers.approval: strong confirmation, verified backup and audit
